svg.title: Modeled time and cost of three check rules
svg.desc: The usual order is 100 percent. Moving tests ahead of human review uses 85.8 percent of modeled time and 85.2 percent of cost. The fastest action uses 78.3 percent of time in the duration-record scenario. The cheapest action uses 84.8 percent of cost.
